    Type D in characteristic two (Appendix B) #

    characteristic-two-mesh-calculations.tex. On a periodic star model of type D_n (N = n − 2) with period c₀ = 2s, a row of path degree 2j exists only for j = 1 + n s with twist θ^n (Lemma A.2(1)), and its class is an integer multiple of the alternating word w_j (trace_D_span), which vanishes for j > N. "The brick hypothesis forces N < 2s. Otherwise delete the terminal part of the long arm, retaining D_{2s+2}. Its top paths have degree 4s, fix the tree vertices, and increase the repetition coordinate by 2s. They become radical endomorphisms at every object, for either trivial action or an interchange." Hence only j = s + 1 remains: all cokernel classes are multiples of the class of the row of w_{s+1} at the centre.

    For the three-cycle of the arms of D_4, all classes vanish.
